scientific_integrity: New assertion concerns the cyclic representation and quotient rational homology; the existing nonequivariant homotopy classification is acknowledged and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic rotations and rational homology are classified; no integral lattice, dihedral reflections, integral quotient homology, or quotient homotopy type is asserted. Uses published nonequivariant clique homotopy theorem.
title: Cyclic homology representations and quotient homology of total two-cut complexes of cycle powers
